A customer stands directly across the checkout counter, facing the camera wearer and within arm’s reach. The register and payment area are in front of the wearer, while the customer reaches toward them; neither person obstructs the other’s path. This places the wearer in the cashier position, ready to receive payment and finish the sale. The appropriate next action is to take the customer’s cash and return the correct change, ensuring the transaction is completed accurately and efficiently.
